kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنخرم (form VII)
# أَنْخَرِمُ (ʔanḵarimu) /ʔan.xa.ri.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# أَنْخَرِمَ (ʔanḵarima) /ʔan.xa.ri.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# أَنْخَرِمْ (ʔanḵarim) /ʔan.xa.rim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
